boundary.title: What relationship data found
boundary.body: A Swedish register study of 66,063 marriages found no consistent evidence that astrologically favored pairs married more often or had a lower divorce risk.

selection.title: Choose two sun signs
selection.desc: Your choices stay in this browser. We do not send signs, birth dates or pair results to analytics.

result.label: Cultural symbols, not a verdict
result.boundary: No score can tell whether two people will communicate well, feel safe, or stay together. Use your real experiences instead.
result.prompt1_body: What does each person need to feel respected, and have you said it clearly?
result.prompt2_body: When you disagree, what behavior helps the conversation stay safe and specific?
result.prompt3_body: What is one small action each person can take after a misunderstanding?
result.evidence_body: Sun-sign pairings did not consistently predict marriage choice or divorce in the large register study. A separate cross-cultural study found little support for sun signs predicting measured personality.
